otel.serviceNameHelp: If kept empty, the service name will be set to "bifrost"
otel.protocolHelp: Transport used for both trace and metrics export.
otel.commonHeadersHelp: Sent to both the trace and metrics endpoints.
otel.insecureSkipTlsHelp: Skip TLS verification. Disable this to use TLS with system root CAs or a custom CA certificate.
otel.tlsCaCertPathHelp: File path to the CA certificate on the Bifrost server. Leave empty to use system root CAs.
otel.enableTraceExportHelp: Export spans to the OTLP collector. Turn off for a metrics-only profile.
otel.traceHeadersHelp: Sent only to the trace endpoint, in addition to the common headers.
otel.exportTimeoutHelp: Maximum time for a single trace export (1-60 seconds). Traces are dropped rather than retried past this limit, so an unreachable collector cannot slow down request handling.
otel.requestHeadersHelp: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture and emit as span attributes. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. x-custom-* captures all headers with that prefix, * captures all headers; note that * will capture sensitive headers like Authorization).
otel.disableContentLoggingHelp: When enabled, message content (input/output messages, tool definitions, and tool call arguments/results) is dropped from exported spans. Only metadata such as model, tokens, and latency is sent to the collector.
otel.groupTracesBySessionHelp: When enabled, requests sharing the same x-bf-session-id header are grouped into a single trace, each request appearing as a top-level sibling span. A request carrying an inbound W3C traceparent stays on its own distributed trace and is unaffected.
otel.disableRootSpanContentHelp: When enabled, input/output message content is dropped from the root span only; the underlying generation (llm.call) span keeps the full content.
otel.enableMetricsExportHelp: Push metrics to an OTEL Collector for proper aggregation in cluster deployments
otel.overheadBreakdownHelp: Export per-component Bifrost overhead latency as a histogram.
otel.metricsHeadersHelp: Sent only to the metrics endpoint, in addition to the common headers (e.g. a Databricks table name).
otel.pushIntervalHelp: How often to push metrics (1-300 seconds)
